plugins.name: pets
plugins.description: An animal roams an isometric world in a docked terminal panel and reacts to session signals

plugins.name: auto-tetris
plugins.description: Draws an auto-playing Tetris in a docked panel, moved only by the tokens the session writes

plugins.name: agent-trace
plugins.description: Draws the subagents, agent teams and Workflows the session launched in a docked panel as a flow diagram and file access

plugins.name: todo-md
plugins.description: Shows only the headings and checklist items of TODO.md (or a given md file) in a docked panel, and redraws when the file changes
